O1.statement: For every input satisfying A1, the admitted solve entry returns the complete specified grouped bucket aggregation. Let G be the sorted distinct event group names and B=[start+k*width | k is natural and start+k*width<end]. For g in G and b in B, let V(g,b) be the list of non-null event values with group g and b<=time<min(b+width,end), retaining duplicates; c(g,b)=length(V(g,b)) and s(g,b)=sum(V(g,b)). Each output row is {group:g,start:b,count:c(g,b),value:v(g,b)}, where v is s when c>0, null when c=0 and fill='none', and otherwise the sum of the latest earlier bucket of the same group with positive count, or null if none exists. Rows occur in group then bucket order. The implementation is canonical vscore/0.3 under normative Lean vscore-semantics/0.3 and data-pipeline/0.3.

acceptance_criteria: The group sequence equals sort(distinct(map group events)) using scalar-codepoint lexicographic comparison.
Groups having no in-range events receive the same prescribed bucket sequence as other groups; with no buckets the result remains empty.
Universal source implementation refinement establishes the group formula.

For O2, program.vscore.json contains one admitted typed solve entry of arity 1 satisfying typed_total, deterministic, input_preserved, no_external_io, no_floating_point, pure_data and restricted_runtime_only.
